tooling.message:
feat(app): preview a pull request in the real app before it is published

## Intent

An increment ends with a pull request, and the creator should try the change in the real app before it goes online. The app's workflow only checked a pull request. Someone who is not technical must understand that the preview is a temporary copy for their own review.

## Key changes

- A new job preview in the app's workflow uses a new app preview action. On a pull request from the app's own repo, after the check passed, the checked bundle goes to gh-pages below pr-preview/pr-<number>/, marked noindex, updated on every push and removed when the pull request closes.
- One comment in German tells the creator what the preview is, where it is, that learners do not see it, and that only the merge publishes; it says so when the preview is gone.
- Plan-only and docs-only changes get no preview.
- The increment template's publish checkpoint shows the creator the preview link.
- Tests run the comment logic against a fake GitHub API; the architecture names the action.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Existing apps must copy the preview job into their workflow by hand; `lernapps update` does not rewrite it.
